mapper.sql: boqs.id AS id, boqs.code AS code, boqs.date AS `date`, boqs.company_id AS companyId, companies.name AS companyName, customers.id AS organizationId, customers.customer_code AS organizationCode, customers.name AS organizationName, customer_contacts.id AS organizationContactId, customer_contacts.contact_name AS organizationContact, boqs.note AS note, boqs.total_cost AS totalCost, boqs.total_price AS totalPrice, boqs.status AS status, CONCAT(approver.first_name, ' ', approver.last_name) AS approvedBy, boqs.created AS created, CONCAT(creator.first_name, ' ', creator.last_name) AS createdBy

FROM boqs LEFT JOIN companies ON companies.id = boqs.company_id LEFT JOIN customers ON customers.id = boqs.customer_id LEFT JOIN customer_contacts ON customer_contacts.id = boqs.customer_contact_id LEFT JOIN users AS approver ON approver.id = boqs.approved_by LEFT JOIN users AS creator ON creator.id = boqs.created_by

WHERE boqs.status >= 0
AND boqs.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter.searchText}, '%')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO boqs ( `date`, company_id, customer_id, customer_contact_id, note, total_cost, total_price, created, created_by, status ) VALUES ( #{boq.date}, #{boq.companyId}, #{boq.organizationId}, #{boq.organizationContactId}, #{boq.note}, #{boq.totalCost}, #{boq.totalPrice}, NOW(), #{boq.createdBy}, 1 )
mapper.select: SELECT boq_details.type_id AS `type`, boq_details.id AS id, boq_details.product_id AS productId, CASE WHEN type_id IN (2,3) THEN boq_details.description ELSE products.name END AS productName, products.code AS sku, products.barcode AS upc, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(name) FROM pgroups WHERE id IN (SELECT pgroup_id FROM product_pgroups WHERE product_id = products.id)) AS productBrand, products.photo AS productPhotoUrl, products.photo_name AS productPhotoName, products.spec AS spec, boq_details.qty AS qty, IFNULL(products.small_val_uom,1) / IFNULL(boq_details.conversion, 1) AS conversion, boq_details.qty_uom_id AS uomId, uoms.name AS uomName, uoms.abbr AS uomAbbr, boq_details.unit_cost AS unitCost, boq_details.total_cost AS totalCost, boq_details.unit_price AS unitPrice, boq_details.total_price AS totalPrice, boq_details.remark AS remark FROM boq_details LEFT JOIN products ON products.id = boq_details.product_id LEFT JOIN uoms ON uoms.id = boq_details.qty_uom_id WHERE boq_details.boq_id = #{boqId} ORDER BY boq_details.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO boq_details ( boq_id, type_id, product_id, description, qty, conversion, qty_uom_id, unit_cost, total_cost, unit_price, total_price, remark ) VALUES ( #{detail.boqId}, #{detail.type}, #{detail.itemId}, #{detail.itemName}, #{detail.qty}, #{detail.conversion}, #{detail.uomId}, #{detail.unitCost}, #{detail.totalCost}, #{detail.unitPrice}, #{detail.totalPrice}, #{detail.remark} )
mapper.update:
UPDATE boqs SET status = #{status},
is_approve = 1,
is_approve = 0,
approved = NOW(), approved_by = #{userId} WHERE id = #{id} AND status > 0;
